u = iπ/2 is a pole of sn AND cn individually (both ~oo at m = 1), but their ratio is finite — sharing one denominator in the m = 1 exact table (see jacobi-elliptic.ts) keeps this from an unresolved ComplexInfinity/ComplexInfinity.

Same gap as JacobiCD (the true value is tracked there, not repeated per head): u this far out has no argument reduction against its real period, so the guard in exceedsDoublePrecision's sibling (periodsExceedDouble, ce-patches/support/precise.ts) declines rather than return a wrong value.
